text:
Rina: Heads-up  guest arriving 3:10pm with a stroller + small box of wax melts. Can we get a temp badge and somewhere to stash the box (fragile)?
Front Desk: We can print a temp badge. Locker or behind desk?
Rina: Locker if possible. Low height preferred. Also reserve the single seat by the lobby window?
Facilities: Low lockers: #1 and #3. #1 has a water bottle, #3 is empty but the hinge squeaks. I can clear #1 quick.
Rina: If you can clear #1 thatd be perfect. Put a FRAGILE sticker on the box too.
PackageBot: Incoming package logged: 1x "Lumen Wax Melts" for Rina. Courier: FleetFast 12345. Status: at front desk awaiting storage.
Front Desk: Roger. We'll clear locker #1, label the box FRAGILE, and print a white-lanyard temp badge. Will DM photo.
Owen: Stroller parking alternative: fold and park against the planter near elevators. Not ideal during peak, though.
Clara: I can pop down at 2:55 to help move stroller if needed.
Rina: Amazing thanks Clara! Sticky note on window seat saying "Reserved 3:10 - Rina's guest"?
Front Desk: Badge printed: "Rina - Guest". Locker #1 cleared and box placed inside. Photo DM sent. We'll hold until 4pm then move to lost & found.
Rina: You guys are the best :heart: Quick poll: keep the window seat reserved? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: let it go
Owen: :thumbsup: keep it, short visit.
Clara: :thumbsup: keep.
Rina: Great, I'll swing by at 3:05. Thanks everyone!
